notes.title: The roll mechanic, camera movement and small changes
notes.notes:
Roll the ball 

If you hold the mouse pointer and rotate the ball in a circle, it will begin to roll in the direction you're rotating the mouse pointer. In short, you can roll the ball by making circles with the mouse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481061/986acea094f0268da51e16a6b165cfb2e9864ba9.gif

Camera movement

You can use the WASD keys to move the camera a little and see a little further ahead.

Cancel jump 

You can now cancel the jump with the right mouse button.

 Small changes  

- Fixed the bug where the gravel sound sometimes played twice.

- Jumps load a little faster now

- Possible improvement in game performance
